entries.name: Ali Khalid Abdullah

expected.charges: Assault with intent to rob while armed, arising from an attempted action against businesses alleged to be drug-dealing fronts.
expected.sentence: Six and a half to twenty years in prison; maximum discharge reported for July 2008.

updates.sentence: Six and a half to twenty years in prison. Released August 1, 2008, according to his first-person update published in 4strugglemag issue 12 (Spring 2009). The earlier July 2008 maximum-discharge forecast was not his actual release date. Arrest and admission remain known only to the year; no exact total is inferred.

entries.rationale: The first-person Update: Ali Khalid Abdullah in4strugglemag issue12(Spring2009) explicitly dates actual release August1,2008. This supersedes the previously stored projected July2008 discharge month. Exact1990 admission and arrest day remain unresolved.
